purpose: O08 resource size, lifetime and logical traffic inventory; not a physical bandwidth measurement or optimization result

device.name: Apple M1 Max
device.format_capability_probe_scope: one-second clearing route used to initialize the adapter and return wgpu format feature reports; timings are discarded
device.format_query_limit: The original query recorded adapter-reported format features. Later effect-target and smoke-volume trials created the selected Rg16Float render attachment, render pipelines, storage textures and compute pipeline on this M1 Max/Metal adapter. Smoke selection also requires and enables TEXTURE_ADAPTER_SPECIFIC_FORMAT_FEATURES; fallback execution on another adapter and other backends remain unverified.

known_allocations.atlas_layer_note: The above breakdown is for measured clearing/heavy scenes, which each have one atlas layer. Material Atelier allocation is from its O01 report and has a smaller geometry buffer.

clearing_or_heavy.notes: Vertex input is seven shadow draws plus opaque draw. These are logical attachment and vertex references, not physical DRAM traffic. Tile memory, caches, compression and overdraw change external traffic. Shader texture reads are variable and excluded. Effect target uses Rg16Float here, reducing modeled full-frame effect-target clear/write traffic by 921600 bytes versus the original Rgba16Float estimate; this remains logical traffic, not measured DRAM bandwidth.

optical_frame_additions.notes: One HDR snapshot is allocated on first optical use and copied each active optical frame. The original normal/depth target is sampled read-only and is no longer copied or attached for optical output. This removes 7,372,800 modeled logical copy/attachment bytes per optical frame versus the prior two-snapshot/two-attachment path; estimates are not physical DRAM traffic.

smoke_compute_per_fixed_step.notes: Nominal source footprint counts two eight-texel filtered samples and one RGBA16F store. The shader uses x/y channels from samples; filtering hardware, channel elimination, caching and implementation details mean this is neither measured bus bandwidth nor guaranteed physical bytes. Current implementation uses two-channel Rg16Float ping-pong volumes; nominal full-texel request arithmetic is halved from the original RGBA16F inventory. This is not measured external-memory traffic.

uploads.notes: The fire frame is cached by its fixed-tick key; without a changed tick, camera-only render refreshes globals/matrices but not FireFrame. Upload payload excludes queue staging/alignment.

evidence_and_candidates.interpretation: Existing route data shows smoke compute well below render stages on this M1 Max/Metal build; active-region simulation is not justified by the current timing. Stage timestamps overlap and route values describe complete variants.

candidates.candidate: Pack effect depth and flame coverage into a two-channel target
candidates.evidence: Rgba16Float target is 8 bytes/pixel; post shader consumes x and y; this M1 Max reports Rg16Float renderable and filterable.
candidates.status: implemented on this M1 Max/Metal adapter with Rgba16Float fallback; matching 640x360 smoke and opaque-metal captures are byte-identical; DX12 and other-adapter validation remain open

candidates.candidate: Use a two-channel density/temperature ping-pong texture
candidates.evidence: Two Rgba16Float volumes total 2359296 bytes; smoke shader writes z/w as zero and consumes x/y; this M1 Max reports Rg16Float write-only storage and filterable.
candidates.status: implemented on this M1 Max/Metal adapter with Rgba16Float fallback; reset/replay GPU verification passed and matched 640x360 smoke and opaque-metal captures are byte-identical; fallback execution, DX12 and other-adapter validation remain open

candidates.candidate: Allocate optical snapshots only for optical scenes
candidates.evidence: The original renderer allocated two full-resolution RGBA16F snapshots unconditionally, although diffuse scenes skip optical copies and resolve.
candidates.status: implemented: diffuse scenes allocate no snapshot; optical scenes allocate one HDR snapshot, saving 3,686,400 bytes in diffuse scenes and a further 1,843,200 bytes on active optical scenes versus the prior pair; live activation remains supported

candidates.candidate: Avoid snapshot copies through pass/layout redesign
candidates.evidence: The normal/depth snapshot copy and second optical attachment were removed; one full-resolution HDR snapshot copy remains to avoid sampling from the HDR target being written.
candidates.status: partially implemented on M1 Max/Metal: one copy and the normal output attachment are removed, saving 7,372,800 modeled logical bytes per optical frame; HDR feedback copy redesign and cross-backend measurements remain open

evidence_and_candidates.not_recommended_from_current_evidence: Active-region smoke simulation: current measured compute is about 0.0205 ms median while post and atmosphere/fire are multi-millisecond stages.

limitations_and_open_gates: No hardware DRAM/bandwidth counters were collected; attachment, copy and filtered-sample byte totals are logical operation estimates.
The only live format capability probe is Apple M1 Max/Metal. Windows DX12 and RTX-class feature reports and measured pass costs remain open.
RG16 capability in this probe does not make it a portable default; query each adapter and retain an RGBA16F fallback unless DX12 and target GPU results pass.
Repeat the inventory after O03/O05/O06 introduce or specialize targets, as required by the plan.
One HDR snapshot and its copy remain necessary in the current pass layout; eliminating it requires a larger sampling/output redesign and matched backend timing.

lazy_optical_snapshots.status: implemented; snapshots allocate on first optical material use and remain allocated for live edit safety

lazy_optical_snapshots.interpretation: memory estimate savings only; no frame-time gain is claimed. Optical scenes allocate full snapshots at startup, and diffuse scenes allocate them at first live optical material edit. Snapshot copy traffic is unchanged on optical frames.
limitations: Known GPU allocation is a descriptor-size estimate and excludes driver alignment, transient allocations, pipelines and timestamp storage.
Measurements cover Apple M1 Max/Metal only; Windows DX12 and other GPU backends remain open.

effect_depth_rg16.selection_requirement: filterable plus RENDER_ATTACHMENT and TEXTURE_BINDING usages
effect_depth_rg16.performance_claim: none; allocation and image parity were measured, not frame-time improvement
effect_depth_rg16.limits: One adapter only; Windows DX12 and unsupported-format fallback behavior on another adapter remain unverified.

smoke_volume_rg16.selection_requirement: adapter reports TEXTURE_ADAPTER_SPECIFIC_FORMAT_FEATURES and Rg16Float is filterable with STORAGE_BINDING and TEXTURE_BINDING usages plus STORAGE_WRITE_ONLY; the device feature is requested only when this path is selected
smoke_volume_rg16.reset_upload: zero-filled volume upload uses selected format bytes-per-voxel row stride
smoke_volume_rg16.deterministic_replay: python3 scripts/verify.py --gpu reset/replay check passed; same-device seed-42 capture after reset matched the initial 120-tick capture byte-for-byte
smoke_volume_rg16.performance_claim: none; allocation and logical texel-request reductions were calculated, not measured as frame-time or external-memory bandwidth gains
smoke_volume_rg16.limits: One adapter only; fallback execution on an adapter lacking the extension/format support, Windows DX12 and other GPU backends remain unverified.

optical_normal_snapshot_removal.removed_optical_attachment: normal/depth color output; original normal/depth target stays read-only and is sampled directly
optical_normal_snapshot_removal.remaining_snapshot: HDR color RGBA16F, required because optical pass writes HDR while sampling the prior scene color
optical_normal_snapshot_removal.performance_claim: none; logical traffic and allocation reductions are estimates, frame-time was not measured
optical_normal_snapshot_removal.limits: One M1 Max/Metal adapter only; Windows DX12 remains unverified.

optical_normal_snapshot_removal.interpretation: No meaningful timing gain established. Optical-resolve paired GPU deltas were mixed and had a -0.004874 ms median; total GPU render median delta was -0.011916 ms, while frame-work deltas were mixed (-0.042875, -0.047626, +0.108209 ms). Three route pairs are insufficient to claim a performance improvement. Memory and logical-traffic reductions are reported separately and are not measured bandwidth.
optical_normal_snapshot_removal.limits: One Apple M1 Max/Metal adapter; short 20-second serial route pairs, no DX12/RTX or native-window results.
